source: derived: horizons marched over the LOLA LDEM 75S 240 m heights at 30 cells and 24 azimuths; Sun and Earth directions from the JPL DE440 ephemerides every 6 h of 2027
note: Longest stretch of 2027 without the Earth above the regional horizon (a night for the Sun, a blackout for the Earth), in hours at the resolution of the sampling (6 h); a stretch that crosses the end of the year is cut. At about 2.4 km per cell: relief smaller than a cell is not resolved. Not validated against NASA illumination products. Cells within 72 km of the rim have no data.
